guide_passage:
The r4 guide's passage (the passage this carries):
Reparenting and identity-building can usually proceed together. But when a firmly held identity includes a current intention to exploit or harm vulnerability, identity and adult-agency work come first; do not bring the child forward to help dismantle the identity. For some people the child-self is already easy to feel. For others, creating the conditions for it to emerge is the first phase.
